## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue/motivation.

## Related Issue
Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] Code is properly formatted (`dart format .`)
- [ ] Static analysis passes with 0 warnings (`flutter analyze`)
- [ ] All unit and widget tests pass (`flutter test`)
- [ ] New tests were added for new behavior/bug fixes
- [ ] Documentation was updated if necessary ([README.md](README.md) / Dart doc comments)
- [ ] Pub.dev publishing dry-run passes with 0 warnings (`flutter pub publish --dry-run`)
